availability_rule: Expand exactly GiveMeSomeCredit, diamonds and SDSS17 because approved existing caches contain official outer-TRAIN only. Carry all nine other tasks unchanged, including houses whose available parquet would decode official-test values. Eligibility is source availability, not development score.
source_integrity: Hash the three specific caches, prepared receipts, historical pilot protocol and historical role plan before unpickling. Reconstruct the historical seed47 10000-row cap with the original LabelEncoder and stratification; verify every original TRAIN/STOP value, label and row ID against the source. Verify DEV IDs and derive the sealed confirmation complement from capped rows, matching its historical count/hash without opening confirmation.pkl.
label_access: Full official-TRAIN labels, including excluded DEV/confirmation labels, are used administratively to replay historical stratification and class vocabulary. The excluded DEV/confirmation labels are never used to fit a model, preprocessing or correction, or to score confirmation. No official-test feature or label is read.
fitting_rows: Original TRAIN then STOP, followed by all outside-cap official-TRAIN positions in ascending order. Exclude every DEV and derived confirmation position. Fit a fresh vocabulary only on these expanded fitting rows. All three libraries use identical rows/order/source hashes for each eligible task.
primary_policy: Nine mandatory fits, one per eligible task/library, at frozen wave13 requested rounds and exact selected tree/post-fit controls. Retain27 other frozen wave13 models. No HPO, early stopping, correction/temperature reselection, or comparison choosing old versus expanded models. A failed expansion closes the gate; never substitute its old model.
postfit: Recompute fixed regression or binary correction coefficients on expanded fitting rows, including exact ordered CT training replay and native folding oracles. Reuse fixed multiclass temperature exactly once. Split-selection design is unchanged.
resources: Primary fits run sequentially on CPU4, one native thread, under the reviewed owned-process-tree watchdog:1200 seconds and8GiB summed tree RSS per fit. Record all failures, requested and actual counts, timing diagnostics, payload bytes and exact prediction round-trip.
freeze: Bind all canonical helpers, seed239 and outer-test companions, policy, source/runtime/SciPy identities and expanded-data receipts. Freeze the complete36-model policy before development scoring.
conditional_seed_trigger: Only a successful initial36-model development gate opens36 new seed239 fits, including27 ordinary TRAIN+STOP refits and9 identical expanded-row refits. No reuse of earlier947 or137 models.
conditional_seed_policy: Change learner seed only. Preserve exact requested rounds, rows, tree controls, fixed correction penalties/shrinkages and temperatures; no new selection. Serial isolated fits on CPU4, one native thread, with the same1200-second/8GiB process-tree watchdog per fit. Average47/239 errors within each of12datasets, then compute task-level medians/wins; report both seeds separately. This is same-split seed sensitivity, not independent replication.
official_test: Only after the two-seed gate, freeze all72 native models, sources, runtime, policy and split/cache identities, then score the uncapped original official outer-test once using already trained models. No subsequent refit or adjustment. Original14 confirmation remains unscored.
failure: Preserve any failed policy and keep the conditional gate/test closed; no fallback to earlier models based on DEV
limitations: Adaptive reused development, inherited controls tuned at smaller sample size, only three tasks expand by source availability, unequal library compute/capacity despite identical row access. More training data can change significance power and regularization together; this is not a CTBoost algorithm improvement, unbiased estimate, official TabArena ranking or universal superiority claim.
